LanguageData.MS_Printer_SettingsDesc: Adjust this printer's work speed, output efficiency and quality settings.
LanguageData.MS_Printer_Hint: Settings apply only to this printer. Production progress is stored in the control core. The worker that finishes a batch determines its output and quality.
LanguageData.MS_Printer_SpeedTip: 100% matches a human colonist's normal work speed.
LanguageData.MS_Printer_EfficiencyTip: Multiplier for the number of items produced.
LanguageData.MS_Printer_SkillTip: Determines which recipes can be crafted and generates base quality using the vanilla formula.
LanguageData.MS_Printer_OffsetTip: Quality levels added to or removed from vanilla base quality.
LanguageData.MS_Printer_InspirationTip: Chance for a finished product to gain one quality level. Independent of malfunction; simultaneous triggers cancel out.
LanguageData.MS_Printer_FailureTip: Chance for a finished product to lose one quality level. Independent of inspiration; simultaneous triggers cancel out.
LanguageData.MS_Printer_EditingLocked: Default parameters cannot be changed. Enable printer parameter changes in the mod options.
LanguageData.MS_Printer_ZeroPauses: The printer cannot work if work speed or output efficiency is zero.
LanguageData.MS_Printer_Idle: Waiting for an available core order
